recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間幾乎沒有脂肪、細胞密度很高，細胞間夾雜淡粉紅色較鬆散的區域；此倍率看不到巨大顆粒，無法單憑此圖確認 Chediak-Higashi 症候群。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat between trabeculae
Mixed hematopoietic population with scattered interstitial eosinophilic, loosely cellular areas
Granule morphology not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat spaces. The intertrabecular space is filled by a mixed hematopoietic population with patchy, looser eosinophilic areas and focal hemorrhage. Cytoplasmic giant granules cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are nonspecific; in the clinical context of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, a hypercellular marrow may reflect ineffective granulopoiesis or an accelerated (HLH-like) phase, to be confirmed on aspirate and high-power examination.

ddx.vs: HLH shows increased histiocytes with hemophagocytosis on high power and aspirate, and CD163 IHC; genetic testing distinguishes familial forms from CHS.
Clonal disorders show atypical megakaryocytes, dysplasia or fibrosis, and cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than giant granules.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation with normal granules on aspirate.
